SHILLONG
NOTICE
NO.HC,M.II1/166/2019_JudI./Part_1/606 Dated Shillong, the 08th October, 2026
It is hereby notified for the information of all concerned that, with immediate effect and until
further orders, urgent matters, if any, during vacations maY be filed and processed through the
following Vacation Officers
1. Shri B.M. Sangma, Joint Registrar (Listing)
Contact No.: 7005449972
2. Shri D. Marbaniang, Assistant Registrar (Filing Section)
Contact No.: 9436733184
3. Shri E. Hujon, Superintendent (Judicial Section)
Contact No ' 8794702216
All urgent matters sought to be filed during vacations shall be accompanied by an application
clearly statIng the nature and grounds of urgency.
Only matters of extreme urgency requiring immediate consideration shall be listed during
vacations. subject to the approval of Hon’ble the Chief Justice
By Order,
REGISTRAR GENERAL
